item.title: How to play pool in GTA 6
item.description: To play pool in Grand Theft Auto 6 , you must find a table and know the rules. You'll likely play your first game of pool during the "Coming Home" mission at the Rusty Anchor, but the game assumes some familiarity with the game of pool. Don't worry; playing pool (and winning!) is easy once you get the hang of it.

item.title: Disney Plus Reveals Official Cast for Zombie Apocalypse Reboot of Classic Comic
item.description: It's been a little over three years since Riverdale , the CW's loose adaptation of the Archie Comics characters, aired its final episode. Now Disney is gearing up to bring audiences back to the town of Riverdale, but it will be in a wildly different way. As announced this July , Disney Plus is set to release an adaptation of the horror comic Afterlife with Archie next year. Now we know who will play Archie , Betty, Veronica, and more.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino's Near-Perfect New Netflix Thriller Could Be the Next 'Knives Out'
item.description: The story behind The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth isn't quite as dramatic, but the ultimate effect is similar. Nobody died. Quentin Tarantino just made the bizarre decision that his 10th film should be his last and that a sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood wasn't going to cut it. So instead of trashing the film like he did with his last failed effort , Tarantino handed the script off to David Fincher. The result is another unusual melding of directorial styles that doesn't always work (it's definitely not the best either Fincher or Tarantino has to offer), but still manages to provide a uniquely fun time at the movies — and also on Netflix later this year.

item.title: Phone apps list in GTA 6
item.description: Phone apps in Grand Theft Auto 6 serve a purpose, but some are far more useful than others. Scooter Bros and RydeMe are among the best, whereas Snapmatic is mostly very disturbing. Nonetheless, you'd probably like to unlock them all.

item.title: Huge New Nvidia Bug Is Ruining Gaming Hardware, Users Say
item.description: Nvidia is in rough shape. As the hardware company scrambles to replace its CEO and co-founder, Jensen Huang , after a series of scandals, it seems the needs of lowly gamers aren’t high on the priority list. Earlier this year, the company ran into controversy over its ugly generative AI-fueled DLSS 5 technology . If you need more evidence that Nvidia is focused on cranking out chips for generative AI rather than supporting its gaming hardware, the company has failed to fix a bug reportedly capable of damaging users’ PCs by writing excessive amounts of data to solid-state drives (SSDs).

item.title: GTA 6’s Best-Kept Secret Is the Most Important Part of the Game
item.description: Considering how much of Grand Theft Auto 6 leaked before its launch, you’d think that Rockstar’s latest wouldn’t have anything left to hide. I mean, we’ve really seen it all. But as players immediately discovered when starting their save file, Rockstar (kind of) managed to keep one secret — and it was a huge one.

item.title: Christopher Nolan Explains Why Fans Will Never See an Odyssey Director’s Cut
item.description: With a runtime of just under three hours, Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey doesn't necessarily need to be any longer , even as an adaptation of Homer's epic poem. Although it isn't Nolan's longest film, fans are always clamoring for more from the prolific director. With The Odyssey 's release on home media , there was some hope that a director's cut or deleted scenes would surface. Nolan has shut that idea down, going so far as to say people will likely never see director's cuts of his films.

item.title: Invincible Officially Addresses Its Worst Season 4 Episode With Season 5 Reveal
item.description: Prime Video’s animated series Invincible has a tradition of announcing the release date for its new seasons with meta shorts showing Mark Grayson (Steven Yeun) chatting with another character in Burger Mart, the fast-food restaurant he worked at before becoming a superhero. The goofy self-referential sketches provide a short summary of the events of the previous season, while also acknowledging fan feedback, from how often Mark loses fights to the unfortunate break in the middle of season 3.

item.title: Parks and Rec's Spiritual Sequel Reveals a Dark Truth About Sitcoms and Streaming
item.description: So when Peacock announced a new comedy series from Parks and Rec creator Mike Schur and its star, Amy Poehler, my initial response was unbridled optimism. If anyone could prove the genre still works, it's the team behind one of the best sitcoms ever, right?

item.title: GTA 6's Free PC Competitor Is Blowing Up on Steam
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here — but only on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X, with PC gamers still waiting for Rockstar Games to officially announce a port of the game. While Grand Theft Auto 5 and GTA Online have been a hit on Steam, Rockstar seems to be in no hurry to bring GTA 6 to PC. Reportedly, though, that will happen sometime in 2027 .
